title: Emphasis
line: Spot the status and the next action in a reply.

beats.caption: You ask for a test run and a clear report.
The agent runs the greeting test locally.
Emphasis draws the status labels as pills.
beats.label: pi-emphasis

takeaway.title: Scan the status first
takeaway.line: The pill points you to what passed and what still needs a check.

title.text: When a reply has several results, a status label helps you see where to look first.

scene.text: The agent runs the greeting test and reports where it passed. The next label calls out the hosted checks it hasn’t run. Emphasis draws those words as coloured pills.

takeaway.text: Read the label and then the named check. That tells you what happened and where the result came from.
